instruction: I am planning to buy a few things on amazon for my company's camping trip next week. I have drafted an email to my manager listing the items for confirmation, but the draft is missing individual prices. Please update them in the TODO placeholders and send the email.
notes: Flow: get passwords, log in to gmail, find the camping-trip draft (show_drafts with query 'camping'), read it (show_draft) to get the '- <qty> X <product> => TODO' lines, then for each listed product search Amazon by name and read its unit price via show_product; compose the new body by replacing each TODO with '$' + quantity*unit price (everything before '=>' and all other lines must stay identical), update the draft body (recipients stay the manager's email as already set in the draft), and send the email from the draft (which deletes the draft and creates the email/thread records). The number of items is only known at runtime; the model assumes three (product-1..3) and gmail-update-draft requires a found price for each distinct listed product, so add/remove product and query objects and adjust the update-draft arity if the draft lists a different count. amazon.search_products/show_product are public endpoints, but amazon-login is included per the every-app-logs-in convention and gated through (logged-in amazon). supervisor-complete-task carries no answer (not a question); its draft parameter is a task record only.

plan: (gmail-update-draft camping-items-draft amazon-token body-with-prices product-1 product-2 product-3)
